blockers.summary: Concrete providers did not honor the base usage-context signature (stage/run_id) and dropped usage attribution.
CostTracker accounting views and persistence were not scoped by run_id; one run's events leaked into another's ledger.
Session terminalization read nonexistent CostTracker properties (total_tokens/total_cost) instead of the run-scoped summary.
Gateway schema branch bypassed the usage-aware boundary, issuing unattributed structured calls.
persist_cost_ledger could label a run reconciled based solely on a nonempty ledger, masking known accounting gaps.
Package and README release identity disagreed with the v1.0.3 claim (stale 1.0.1).

bounded_claim: v1.0.3 claims run-isolated cost accounting; stage/run attribution across all five concrete providers' complete_with_usage and structured_output_with_usage; structured-output accounting via the usage-aware gateway boundary; an explicit partial/reconciled/no_events reconciliation posture; honest session finalization from the run-scoped summary; and consistent release identity at 1.0.3. The claim is bounded to the focused reconciliation suites; full-branch CI and a confirmatory E2E remain pending.
